capabilities: Synchronize a vault across desktop and mobile devices via a Seafile server
Merge conflicting edits automatically with preserved conflict copies
Browse and restore per-file and whole-vault version history
Control which settings, core-plugin, and community-plugin data sync
Diagnose and repair sync problems with verification reports and index rebuilds
extras: README warns the plugin is still under development with a risk of data corruption or loss and advises keeping backups; the original plugin is credited to @conql.
intentEvidence: Original plugin by @conql. This continuation is maintained by @ryanravn
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to synchronize a vault across devices through a self-hosted Seafile server.

relations.evidence: synchronizing notes across devices using Seafile, an open-source, self-hosted file sync
Original plugin by @conql. This continuation is maintained by @ryanravn

summary: Sync plugin that synchronizes a vault across devices through a self-hosted Seafile server, with conflict merging, version history, and repair tools.
